purpose: Test one exact alternative Sentinel-2 pair for a locally projected, masked, ArcGIS-openable before/after visual map over the source and upper-corridor AOIs, without change analysis or scientific admission.

source_evidence.rights_assessment: Sentinel source data are under the free, full and open Sentinel legal notice. Portal ancillary content has separate restrictions; do not publish provider quicklooks. Fresh account access and any changed terms require execution-time review. Any later public Sentinel-derived map must carry the required Copernicus Sentinel data credit and its own publication authority.

exact_pair.temporal_limit: After scene is 26 days after the event; intervening weather, terrain, and human changes cannot be attributed to the 26 August event from this pair alone.

proposed_single_conditional_envelope: Record the exact source, access, rights, provenance, integrity plan, fitness limits, and security controls; stop on any unresolved current terms or identity conflict.

Implement portable synthetic and installed ArcGIS-runtime disposable tests for the exact N0512/N0513 pair, 20 m grid, masks, receipt durability, and local visual-map export; stop if processing-baseline differences cannot be handled without scientific threshold changes.
Publish only sanitized implementation and gate evidence to the public default branch, then require passing public CI and an exact no-content preflight before protected reads.

Perform at most one new read-only single-scene SCL and quality-mask screen of the exact existing M2-OPT-001 bytes over AOI-SOURCE and AOI-UPPER-CORRIDOR; require at least 0.80 usable single-date area in each as a conservative acquisition-prerequisite screen, not a scientific admission decision. Stop if either fails or evidence is indeterminate.

Only on the preceding pass, receive one fresh owner-controlled CDSE token via the existing anonymous single-use in-memory broker; request the exact after UUID once from byte zero with no resume or retry; verify provider checksum, local SHA-256, container identity and required files; promote only to non-Git custody without replacement.

Only on verified acquisition, run at most one fresh exact-pair header and pixel-QA attempt on the frozen 20 m EPSG:32645 grid, retaining existing SCL classes, quality masks, registration method and thresholds. Record source and corridor results separately; report overview as partial context. Stop on the first failed or indeterminate gate.

Only on QA pass for a target AOI, create a local masked ArcGIS before/after display for that AOI, then reopen and export in a fresh ArcGIS process. Preserve all intermediate and terminal receipts. Publish sanitized terminal status and CI reconciliation, but no source or derived pixels.
